Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next step ask — FinEdge inference pilot

Hi Elias — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary of the call
- Primary use case: low-latency reranking and chat assistant for mortgage underwriting flows (peak 60 qps, median request length ~180 tokens).
- Key constraints: PII stays in VPC, SOC2 evidence, predictable latency at p95 <= 250ms.
- Success metric for pilot: match current latency while reducing per-token cost by 30–40% vs. existing setup.

Action items we agreed
1) Redwood: provide a one-week pilot on Dedicated with a pre-configured model variant, initial SOW draft, and a short security summary. Attachments: SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf, redwood-security-summary.pdf.
2) FinEdge: share procurement contact and a primary technical contact for connectivity and test dataset (anonymized).
3) Schedule a 30-min runbook walkthrough once pilot access is provisioned.

Proposed timeline
- Pilot provisioned: week of Apr 19
- Runbook + smoke test: within 48 hours of provisioning
- Pilot evaluation: 7 days of traffic

If that still matches, next concrete step from your side is to confirm procurement contact and whether FinEdge wants Redwood to spin up a VPC peering or a private link.

I’ve attached the SOW draft and a short security summary to speed the procurement review. If it helps I can also loop in our security engineer for a quick Q&A.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf (PDF), redwood-security-summary.pdf (PDF)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next step ask — FinEdge inference pilot

Stephanie — a couple of quick technical notes to keep in the SOW and runbook so procurement doesn't get surprised: 

- We should propose a model bundle that includes a quantized 4-bit variant for cost and an fp16 fallback for corner cases. Call out expected token throughput and memory.
- For latency at p95 <= 250ms at 60 qps, recommend a 2-GPU Dedicated pool with continuous batching disabled for their low-latency path and a small burst pool for higher concurrency tests.
- We'll enable prefix/KV caching for repeated session patterns; mention cache TTL and invalidation.

I'll draft a one-page tech appendix you can attach to the SOW. If they prefer Private deployment we should flag potential network setup timelines (VPC peering vs Private Link).

—Dev
